task.task: Propose minimal repairs for supported findings and their measured routing dependencies. Address or link restoration may also require listed missing default/static routes to be restored; include all measured dependencies. Include preconditions, expected effects, checks, rollback restore_captured_state. No shell commands. Use exact topology intent for addresses and next hops.

action_semantics.address_add: Restore the exact intended IPv4 address on the interface with address_missing.
action_semantics.firewall_clear: Remove injected filter rules for a measured firewall_drop; local intended filter is empty.
action_semantics.link_down/route_delete/address_delete: Introduce or preserve faults; not restorative repair actions.
action_semantics.link_up: Set an administratively down interface UP; restores a link_down fault on that interface.
action_semantics.route_replace: Restore the intended gateway for route_missing/route_wrong, or a measured absent route whose gateway lies in an interface subnet restored by address_add or link_up in the same plan.
